name: Bludit Remote Content synchronization
description: Webhook-triggered replacement of site content from a configured remote ZIP archive, parsing imported Markdown pages into the CMS. The process deletes existing pages and uploads before regenerating content.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
metadata.overlap: Independent Bludit extension or subsystem; compose with the CMS host rather than treating internal lifecycle methods as separate assets.
metadata.deployment_warning: Destructive replacement and direct ZIP extraction: use only with trusted archives, backups and an isolated deployment after adding archive/path validation and recovery handling.
